text:
Zoe: Heads up— BART just announced temporary suspension at Embarcadero due to high winds. Trains are holding.
Raj: Just saw the alert. Ugh. Anyone near 5th & Mission needing a lift? I can swing by if it's safe.
Lila: Omg yes please. My umbrella turned inside out twice already. :wind_face: :umbrella:
Carlos: If BART is down, Ferry or Muni? Ferry looks packed on the app.
transit-bot: [alert] BART service suspended between Embarcadero and 19th St due to debris on tracks. ETA unknown. Please check status before travel.
Zoe: Thanks bot. Might WFH if this drags. Quick poll: stay at office or head home? (reply with "office" or "home")
Raj: office -> I left my power cable here, otherwise home.
Lila: home! commute is nonsense.
Carlos: office, but can give @Lila a ride. Meet near lobby in 10?
Lila: Yes please, Ill bring an extra umbrella for the car.
FacilitiesBot: Reminder: building lobby doors might be stuck with wet shoes. Janitorial will bring extra mats in 15m.
Zoe: shoutout to the cafe barista who handed out napkins and a bunch of plastic bags for soggy backpacks. Hero move. :coffee: :clap:
Raj: If anyone needs a dry spot for shoes, I've got a bin in desk area D. First come, first serve.
Carlos: Also, pro tip: if ferry is full, try the south-side dock, less tourist traffic this hour.
transit-bot: [update] BART reports crews en route to clear debris. Minor residual delays expected once service resumes.
Zoe: ok team, carpool happening. Thanks everyone. And someone meme this experience pls.
Lila: on it. dropping a GIF of a soggy pigeon now.
Carlos: Safe travels y'all. If anyone stranded, DM and we'll coordinate rides.
Raj: Leaving lobby in 5. Majestic soggy-commute energy. :sweat_smile:
